pool.text: The current building was constructed during the Muromachi period.
Ōta Dōkan built Edo Castle to defend the region from the Chiba clan.
The Later Hōjō clan replaced the Uesugi clan after the Battle of Takanawahara.
Toyotomi Hideyoshi defeated the Later Hōjō clan during the Siege of Odawara.
Edo became the seat of the Tokugawa shogunate and rose to political prominence.
The Ueno Toshogu maintains the original building built by third shogun Iemitsu Tokugawa.
The Tokyo Metro Ginza Line was completed between Ueno and Asakusa.
Yasunari Kawabata depicted the decadent allure of Tokyo in his series.
Haneda has served as the primary airport for Tokyo since this year.
The May 15 incident occurred as an attempted military coup d'état.
The former Tokyo House of Yasuhiko was built in an opulent Art Deco style.
The February 26 incident occurred as an attempted military coup d'état.
Tokyo City merged with Tokyo Prefecture to form the Tokyo Metropolis.
Typhoon Kathleen struck Tokyo, destroying 31,000 homes and killing 1,100 people.
The Science Council of Japan was established to promote scientific research and applications.
Tokyo celebrated its 500th anniversary during the period of rapid rebuilding.
Typhoon Ida dropped 400 mm of rain in a single week causing streets to flood.
Hotel Okura Tokyo opened as one of the luxury hotels in the city.
Tokyo hosted the Summer Olympics and Paralympics as the first Asian city.
Michelin released their first guide for fine dining in Tokyo awarding 191 stars.
